tests.mutation: Die.D6 constructed a five-faced die; this test went red.

The outcome table gave a doublet 2 ways and an unlike pair 1 (`higher == lower ? 2 : 1`), so the ways no longer counted ordered pairs of six faces; this test went red. The faces themselves come from DicePair.OfSixes, so a five-faced die turns it red as well (mutations/turnloop-chance.json).

TurnLoop.CheckFaces accepted a face above the die's six (the upper bound `outcome.First > Faces || outcome.Second > Faces` removed), so a 7 stepped to a throw no die shows; this test went red (mutations/turnloop-chosen.json).
